import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Top 10 dog breeds in Zurich
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
bars = ax1.barh(range(len(breed_counts)), breed_counts.values)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(breed_counts)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(breed_counts.index, fontsize=9)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.invert_yaxis()
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, breed_counts.values)):
    ax1.text(count + max(breed_counts.values)*0.01, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, 
             f'{count:,}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog distribution by age group
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
age_order = sorted(df['AlterVHundLang'].dropna().unique(), 
                   key=lambda x: int(x.split('-')[0]) if '-' in x else 0)
age_counts = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().reindex(age_order)
bars = ax2.bar(range(len(age_counts)), age_counts.values)
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(age_counts)))
ax2.set_xticklabels(age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age Group', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Dog Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, age_counts.values)):
    ax2.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + max(age_counts.values)*0.01,
             f'{count:,}', ha='center', fontsize=8, rotation=0)

# 3. Dog gender distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
gender_counts = df['SexHundLang'].value_counts()
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(gender_counts.values, labels=gender_counts.index, 
                                   autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
ax3.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Dog registration trend over years
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
year_counts = df['StichtagDatJahr'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax4.plot(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2.5, markersize=8)
ax4.fill_between(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, alpha=0.3)
ax4.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Registrations', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Dog Registration Trend (2015-2025)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
for year, count in zip(year_counts.index, year_counts.values):
    ax4.text(year, count + max(year_counts.values)*0.02, f'{count:,}', 
             ha='center', fontsize=9)

# 5. Top districts by dog population
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
district_counts = df['KreisLang'].value_counts().head(10)
bars = ax5.bar(range(len(district_counts)), district_counts.values)
ax5.set_xticks(range(len(district_counts)))
ax5.set_xticklabels([d.replace('Kreis ', '') for d in district_counts.index], 
                    rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax5.set_xlabel('District Number', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Top 10 Districts by Dog Population', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, district_counts.values)):
    ax5.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + max(district_counts.values)*0.01,
             f'{count:,}', ha='center', fontsize=8, rotation=0)

# 6. Owner age distribution
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
owner_age_order = sorted(df['AlterV10Lang'].dropna().unique(), 
                         key=lambda x: int(x.split('-')[0]) if '-' in x else 0)
owner_age_counts = df['AlterV10Lang'].value_counts().reindex(owner_age_order)
bars = ax6.bar(range(len(owner_age_counts)), owner_age_counts.values)
ax6.set_xticks(range(len(owner_age_counts)))
ax6.set_xticklabels(owner_age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax6.set_xlabel('Owner Age Group', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Number of Owners', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Dog Owner Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, owner_age_counts.values)):
    ax6.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + max(owner_age_counts.values)*0.01,
             f'{count:,}', ha='center', fontsize=8, rotation=0)

# Adjust layout and add main title
plt.suptitle('Zurich Dog Registration Analysis: Breed, Age, Gender & Distribution Patterns', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
